requirement: Implement all Epic 2 stories: replace the legacy lesson library with one safe local v1.1 draft, strict JSON interchange, and a manual-only active workspace.

architecture.decision: Introduce a strict PatternDocument boundary over the existing in-memory Pattern. The active UI owns one document and persists it only through a single v1.1 draft key; import is fully parsed and validated before any replacement.
alternatives: Adapt the legacy Lesson schema and multi-record lesson index for v1.1.
Persist reactive editor state directly as separate localStorage values.
tradeoffs: A dedicated document boundary makes export, import, validation, and dirty comparison exact and keeps transient UI/audio state out of storage.
Replacing rather than migrating the old library intentionally rejects legacy documents and removes catalogue behavior.
seams: src/document.ts owns v1.1 document construction, validation, serialization, and equality.
src/storage.ts owns only the stylophone-beat:v1.1:draft browser key.
src/DraftPanel.tsx and src/App.tsx own safe user actions, dirty confirmation, and atomic UI replacement.
The legacy source, reduction, lesson, and sidecar files remain in the repository but are not reachable from the rendered app.

tasks.title: Record Epic 2 Story 1 as in progress
tasks.intent: Synchronize the Epic and net trackers with the durable execution plan before implementation begins.
constraints: Preserve all completed Epic 1 tracker rows.
tasks.acceptance: Both trackers show Epic 2 Story 1 In progress and the plan is valid JSON.
tasks.result: Marked Epic 2 Story 1 In progress in both trackers and created the durable seven-task execution queue.

tasks.title: Add strict v1.1 document and single-draft persistence APIs
tasks.intent: Define the exact schema v3 document boundary, its safe import/export contract, and the one local browser draft key.
constraints: Reject schemas 1 and 2; do not migrate.
Accept exactly 12 known pad lanes of 64 booleans and valid non-overlapping bass starts.
Never mutate parsed input or stored data in place.
tasks.acceptance: Document creation, deep equality, Blob export, strict parse validation, and load/save/clear draft functions satisfy the Epic API contracts; invalid input leaves no storage mutation.
tasks.result: Added the strict copied schema-v3 PatternDocument boundary and one-key draft APIs; legacy storage exports remain only until the active UI replacement.
evidence: strict document and simulated localStorage harness (exit 0)

tasks.title: Replace the active lesson library with a durable single-draft workflow
tasks.intent: Restore the local draft on load, save editor changes, accurately track dirty state, and require explicit New/Reset replacement decisions.
constraints: Export and Cancel are offered before a dirty destructive action.
New/Reset creates a new UUID and default title.
Clearly describe browser-storage loss risk and export backup.
Keep the grid and audio behavior intact.
tasks.acceptance: A saved draft restores after reload; New/Reset cannot discard unsaved edits without explicit confirmation; no multi-lesson list, load, or delete flow remains reachable.
verify: clean-reload browser draft and dirty-confirmation interaction check
tasks.visual: Use the local desktop UI to save, reload, edit, and invoke New/Reset; inspect the utility dialog and browser console.
tasks.result: Replaced the active multi-lesson library with one guarded local draft, document-based dirty state, export backup, and in-app replacement confirmation.
evidence: clean reload browser: edited step 1 persisted (aria-pressed=true; is-filled)

tasks.title: Add atomic v1.1 JSON import and export interactions
tasks.intent: Expose safe title-based export and strict import through the draft utility without corrupting the current editor on failure.
constraints: Validate a complete candidate before React state or local storage replacement.
Reject non-JSON extension as a convenience check while treating contents as authoritative.
tasks.acceptance: A valid exported document round-trips exactly; invalid JSON, legacy 32-step document, oversize file, invalid pad/bank, and overlap show recoverable errors and retain the current draft.
tasks.visual: Inspect status/error feedback in the draft dialog after valid and invalid imports.
tasks.result: Added strict extension/size gating, parse-before-mutation import, recoverable errors, and storage-first atomic v3 replacement while preserving export backups.

tasks.title: Mark Story 1 and Story 2 complete
tasks.intent: Run the relevant regression gates and update both trackers only after durable drafting and interchange are verified.
constraints: Do not claim audible output without an output-device check.
tasks.acceptance: Stories 1 and 2 trackers are Done with recorded build, pure-check, and browser evidence.
tasks.visual: Review the utility dialog on a clean local reload.
tasks.result: Marked Stories 1 and 2 Done in both v1.1 trackers after build, strict-document, browser reload, and diff checks.

tasks.title: Remove the generator and source workflow from the active workspace
tasks.intent: Make manual grid authoring the only rendered creation path while retaining legacy source and sidecar files in the repository.
constraints: Do not start or expose the sidecar.
Do not leave an upload or localhost-processing launcher in the rendered app.
tasks.acceptance: No SourcePanel, reduction route, upload control, or active localhost processing call is reachable from the app; production build succeeds with no sidecar running.
tasks.visual: Inspect the desktop workspace and utility controls for the absence of source/generator UI.
tasks.result: Removed SourcePanel, reduction plumbing, source launcher, and source modal from App; retained legacy files and the Draft/Backup utility.

tasks.title: Verify Epic 2 and close its trackers
tasks.intent: Perform final build, diff, and desktop UI checks, then mark Story 3 and the Epic execution plan complete.
constraints: Preserve unrelated worktree changes and do not commit without authorization.
tasks.acceptance: All Epic 2 stories show Done, build/diff checks pass, browser evidence covers the strict draft workflow and manual-only workspace, and the durable plan records each completed task.
tasks.visual: Clean desktop reload verifies a saved draft, safe utilities, recoverable import errors, and no generator UI.
tasks.result: Epic 2 passed final build, static surface scan, clean-reload draft persistence, and Draft/Backup import control checks; all three stories are closed.
evidence: clean local browser: source launcher absent, Draft/Backup present, one JSON file input present, edited step restored after reload
